paper_title: $M^3EL$ A Multi-task Multi-topic Dataset for Multi-modal Entity Linking
caption: : Entity topic distribution.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of different topics, consisting of five distinct categories. The categories are marked in various colors with corresponding labels, each displaying an approximate percentage. The slices include "Moive" in light blue, representing 41.2%, "Common" in green at 14.9%, "Person" in pink at 30.5%, "Book" in light yellow at 9.1%, and "Sport" in lavender at 4.3%. The chart is accompanied by a legend in the center of the chart that clarifies the color coding for each topic. Each slice has its percentage displayed inside. The slices are not ordered in any particular order. None of the slices appear to be visually emphasized beyond their proportionate sizes.
